factor_name: VIX Shock and Cross-Asset Dispersion 3-Day Reversal

calculation.expression: where(lag1(VIX_return > rolling_quantile(VIX_return,60,0.75)) AND lag1(cross_sectional_return_dispersion > rolling_quantile(dispersion,60,0.75)), -rolling_sum(asset_return,3)); cross_sectional_median_center
calculation.description: Apply a three-day cross-sectional reversal only on dates following both an elevated one-day VIX shock and elevated cross-asset return dispersion. The signal is median-centered across the 15 tradable instruments. All regime inputs are lagged one completed day.

validation.regime_notes: Conditional sample is small: 88 valid 5-day IC observations, average N 14.05. IC by regime was -0.0952 in 2020-22 (12 dates), +0.0894 in 2023-24 (11), +0.1110 in 2025-26 (15), and +0.2073 in 2027 (1). Interpret uncertainty conservatively; admission passes benchmark absolute IC and ICIR gates.
